init.title: POBOVi Ring options
init.description: Configure how often this ring is polled and where to send its data. Each ring has its own API key, so each one writes to a different SparkyFitness profile.

data.enable_realtime: Also take HRV, SpO2 and temperature readings
data.sparky_api_key: SparkyFitness API key (leave blank to keep the current key)
data.ring_profile_enabled: Write the ring profile on every sync
data.ring_stride_cm: Stride length (0 = let the ring decide)

data_description.enable_realtime: Heart rate is always sampled so every poll actually syncs. Enabling this adds HRV, SpO2 and temperature, which uses more ring battery.
data_description.sparky_api_key: Create one in SparkyFitness under Settings while signed in as the person whose profile should receive this ring's data.
data_description.sparky_source: Defaults to the ring name. Used to tell rings apart in SparkyFitness.
data_description.ring_profile_enabled: Sends cmd 0x31 so the ring can calculate calories, distance and step length without the vendor app.
data_description.ring_gender: The protocol only carries two values: 'male' sends 1, 'unspecified' sends 0.
data_description.ring_birthdate: Age is derived from this; the ring receives year - 1900.
data_description.ring_stride_cm: Sent in centimetres, matching the app. Leave at 0 to let the ring derive it from height.
data_description.ring_cycle_enabled: Sends cmd 0x15 so the ring can track and predict the cycle. Only needed for a ring worn by someone who uses this feature.
data_description.ring_cycle_start: First day of the most recent period. The ring receives year - 1900.
data_description.ring_cycle_length: Typical number of days between period starts.
data_description.find_ring_seconds: How long the ring buzzes when the Find ring button is pressed.

error.api_key_required: An API key is required when SparkyFitness pushing is enabled.
error.url_required: A SparkyFitness URL is required when SparkyFitness pushing is enabled.
